FileIdentity.description: Stable native identity data; obtaining or checking it belongs to the access implementation.

device.description: Filesystem device or Windows volume identifier.

high.description: Upper 64 bits of a Windows file ID; zero on Unix.

inode.description: Unix inode or the lower 64 bits of a Windows file ID.

ObjectBinding.description: A one-shot selection which must not silently bind a replacement or another device.

identity.description: Identity captured by the trusted host from an actual observation.

relative.description: Exact relative selection under the configured root, or empty for an exact file root.

anyOf.description: An explicit configuration path or variable expression, resolved by the existing resolver.
A validated relative location under the current user's home on the task's platform.

user_home.description: Normal relative components, without separators, traversal, or empty components.

anyOf.description: An observed absolute location bound to its originating machine.

host_id.description: Originating machine identity. Another machine must explicitly rebind the rule.

local_absolute.description: Exact local absolute path; never guessed from a drive letter or similar filename.

RootSpec.description: A persistent location expression. It never stores a session's opaque evidence identifier.

description: Typed built-in filesystem root declaration. Third-party handler options remain extensible.

bindings.description: Required object bindings for saved one-shot selections; absent for recurring rules.

exclude.description: Hard protections, independent of default recommendation thresholds.

include.description: Include predicates relative to this root.

title: FilesystemRoot
